## Change control

This repository uses aidd. Before you plan, implement, or land any change, load the skill at `.agents/skills/aidd/SKILL.md` and follow `.agents/skills/aidd/references/loop.md`. The `aidd/gate` status decides whether a change may merge. Agents never approve, merge, or edit the tests after the Spec is approved. A person decides by typing it at the agent's prompt (`approve SPEC-1`, `land it`, `publish`), and aidd records it before the agent reads it. Work stays on this machine until they type `publish`. The agent then says what it does now, where it stops next for them, and how to stop it, and goes on. In their own terminal, they run `aidd approve spec SPEC-1`, then `aidd land` (or `aidd approve merge` on a pull request), and `aidd publish`. Mark every commit you author with `Assisted-by: <harness>/<model>`.
